sentence_segmentation: split at terminal punctuation followed by whitespace or at newlines; heuristic, no semantic claim
repetition_metric: extra occurrences after first exact normalized sentence occurrence, weighted by sentence word count / all thinking words; descriptive exact repetition, not a semantic validity label
